gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma (GBM); Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma; Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer; Esophageal Cancer

candidate_evidence.quote: This intervention involves the use of \[18F\]AlF-NOTA-PCP2, a radiopharmaceutical agent specifically designed for PET/CT imaging.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: The study involves at least 20 patients (5 per tumor type) who will undergo a pre-treatment PET/CT scan following an intravenous injection of \[18F\]AlF-NOTA-PCP2.

role_evidence.quote: This intervention involves the use of \[18F\]AlF-NOTA-PCP2, a radiopharmaceutical agent specifically designed for PET/CT imaging.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational PD-L1-targeted PET radiotracer (isotope 18F, Al-18F NOTA-chelated peptide PCP2), diagnostic
arms: [18F]AlF-NOTA-PCP2 PET/CT Imaging for PD-L1 Expression in Malignant Tumors

source_quote.quote: Detectable PD-L1 expression in tumor tissue (based on immunohistochemistry or biopsy).
This exploratory outcome measure will investigate the correlation between circulating PD-L1 levels, exosomal PD-L1, and \[18F\]AlF-NOTA-PCP2 PET/CT imaging for assessing PD-L1 expression in tumors.

coder_notes: Diagnostic PET imaging basket study (GBM, HNSCC, NSCLC, oesophageal cancer); no therapeutic agent. The two registered diagnostic-test interventions are the same tracer, listed as one agent row (diagnostic_agent, radiopharmaceutical). PD-L1 tumour expression is an entry requirement but there is no candidate, so not candidate-matched. Treatment setting not stated (pre-treatment scan).
